description: Egress policy on connections reused across executions: the shared MCP server's sessions share one keep-alive pool (httpx or aiohttp) to two destinations; permissive executions may use both, restricted ones only the first. Send binding on. With per_send=0 the policy decides only at connect (cgroup/connect4) and a restricted execution can send over a connection a permissive one opened; with per_send=1 the BPF LSM program on socket_sendmsg re-authorizes every send by the sending thread's identity. Reference: the destination's per-request log (which operations' requests arrived).
